Synopsis:
    Routine MLS roster transaction roundup covering player signings, loans, and trades across seven clubs. Key moves include San Diego FC signing veteran forward Cedrick Bakambu, New England loaning Joshua Wynder from Benfica, Chicago Fire acquiring Noah Allen from Inter Miami and offloading Joel Waterman to Portland, Houston landing Lyle Foster on loan from Burnley, and several allocation money/roster slot exchanges between Austin, Charlotte, NYC FC, Toronto, and Sporting KC.
